module: Manages the zone bounds of the collision test scenario (crash test). Loads a .sites.json file of the mission (bounds.sites.json, or boundsStep<id>.sites.json if the step has its own file) and checks every frame whether the player's vehicle is outside all the zones. If so, it calls gameplay_crashTest_scenarioManager.onPlayerOutOfBounds(). Also draws the zones in white, or in flashing red when the player is outside.
notes: Probable bug: in checkOutOfBounds, the loop 'for i = 0, 8' always calls oobb:getPoint(0) instead of getPoint(i); only the box's first corner is tested.

Probable bug: setParameters tests params.drawBoundsWhenNear_ == nil (with a trailing underscore) and then sets drawBoundsWhenNear to true; the field is therefore never actually read and drawing is enabled as soon as a file is given.
setDebug stores isBeingDebugged but this variable is never used elsewhere.
checkForStepBoundsFile contains a debug dump("new step") left in the code.
Depends on the foreground mission (gameplay_missions_missionManager) to resolve the bounds file paths.

setParameters.desc: Loads the bounds zones from a sites file and finalizes them. Without filePath, removes the bounds and sets isPlayerOutOfBounds back to false.

params.desc: Table with filePath (string): path of the .sites.json file; drawBoundsWhenNear_ (see notes).

setDebug.desc: Stores a debug flag (not used elsewhere in the file).

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame: tests whether the player vehicle is out of bounds, notifies scenarioManager if so and draws the bounds.

onNewCrashTestStep.desc: Hook called at the start of a crash test step: loads this step's bounds file (or bounds.sites.json by default).

deactivateBounds.desc: Disables the bounds (equivalent to setParameters without filePath).
